issues: Each card face had only two colour bars and a star, so the set did not read as anything in particular and the 8 cards looked nearly identical
An indigo-to-magenta rainbow ran across the fan on a pure black ground, like a set of swatches rather than a product
Cards popped in at even intervals and landed without weight; once fanned the shot simply stopped, with no hero or message at the end
The cards were small in frame (110×150 in design units) with large empty black margins
changes: Switched to the porcelain look as a template library: cards scaled to 320×440 native px, each with a generative cover (gantt, bars, line, rings, table, calendar, kanban, big number), a 32px title and mono metadata, covers limited to light cobalt, teal and ink tints
Nine cards (odd, so there is a centre card) stacked in index order, each overlapping the one to its left like a fanned hand, so the top card never swaps between stack and fan
Entries accelerate (40f span with an EASE.out stagger); each card lands on a spring (damping 13) and presses the whole stack down 5px, with alternating flight tilt and vertical motion blur

The stack tightens 2% as an anticipation beat, then fans out on a low-damping spring (one slight overshoot, like a flick of the wrist); the camera pushes to 1.06 during stacking and pulls back to 0.88 during the fan
Ending: the solid-cobalt centre card 'Q4 Launch' slides out 72px with an outline and a single sheen while an 88px 'Start from a template.' rises word by word, then a 28f hold; duration 126→150f
